headline: Executive order creates a presidential task force to study policing in the 21st century.
what_it_does: This order sets up a group called the President's Task Force on 21st Century Policing. Based on the title, the group's job is to look at policing issues and advise the President. No summary was provided, so details about members, duties, and deadlines are not covered here.

who_it_affects.group: Police departments and law enforcement agencies
who_it_affects.how: Their practices are the likely subject of the task force's study and advice.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed December 18, 2014; executive orders like this usually take effect when signed.
